description: recipe.first-draft 1.4.0 asks the model to write each unit as one of the unit words CreatorPantry recognises, listed in REFERENCES. That request is the prompt's, and this harness never calls a model, so no fixture can show a model obeyed it; what this one fixes in place is the pipeline's answer for when one did not. A draft whose units read 'knob' and 'T.' validates: the shape is sound and nothing here rewrites a unit. Acceptance then matches each word to the catalogue deterministically, keeps an unmatched word as written with no unit, and the editor and readiness checklist flag it for the creator. Refusing the answer instead would throw away a whole draft over a word the creator can settle in one pick, which is why no reason code is added for this and none should be.
